links.outcome: Clinician and nurse usability feedback during pilot and its use to revise the tool
links.effect: Interviews with nurses and physicians identified barriers (interpreting results, time constraints, changing routines, buy-in); feedback informed four improved versions of the tool.
links.quote: User-centered feedback informed four improved versions of the tool.

unlisted_practices: Heart rate variability-based prognostic decision support for ED patients with suspected infection, assessed for feasibility of data capture

screen.reason: Prospective feasibility deployment study assessing clinician usability, workflow integration, barriers, and drivers for an HRV-based clinical decision support tool for infection prognostication, but it does not test a specific safeguard/deployment practice comparatively.
